newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Jan 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Jan 14.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Surge in car sales in Saudi Arabia is expected this year, market analysts say.
- A Saudi-Danish joint venture for environment protection is being set up in Jeddah, Danish ambassador says.
- Arabian Cement Company's sales rose to two million tonnes in 1996, official says.
- Trade exchange between Saudi Arabia and Egypt in 1996 reached 2.23 billion pounds, report.
